title: Concept: CSRF protection disabled (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, skip_before_action[^#]*verify_authenticity_token removes the unguessable-token check browsers cannot forge. Exempted endpoints trust ambient credentials alone. The remedy is restoring protect_from_forgery.
applicability: ruby web handlers and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-site request forgery on state-changing endpoints; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for account and payment actions.
